order_shipped_chk.name: order_shipped_chk
order_shipped_chk.value: "order"."status" not in ('shipped', 'completed') or "order"."tracking_number" is not null

mail_outbox_expiry_chk.name: mail_outbox_expiry_chk
mail_outbox_expiry_chk.value: "mail_outbox"."one_time_purpose" is null or "mail_outbox"."expires_at" is not null

mail_outbox_recipient_chk.name: mail_outbox_recipient_chk
mail_outbox_recipient_chk.value: ("mail_outbox"."order_id" is null and "mail_outbox"."recipient" is null) or ("mail_outbox"."order_id" is not null and "mail_outbox"."recipient" in ('buyer', 'seller') and "mail_outbox"."one_time_purpose" is null)

mail_outbox_purged_chk.name: mail_outbox_purged_chk
mail_outbox_purged_chk.value: "mail_outbox"."bodies_purged_at" is null or ("mail_outbox"."text_body" = '' or "mail_outbox"."text_body" = '[dihapus]') and "mail_outbox"."html_body" is null

approval_request_state_chk.name: approval_request_state_chk
approval_request_state_chk.value: ("approval_request"."status" not in ('approved', 'rejected', 'executed') or "approval_request"."decided_by" is not null) and ("approval_request"."status" <> 'pending' or "approval_request"."decided_by" is null)

operator_grant_event_source_actor_chk.name: operator_grant_event_source_actor_chk
operator_grant_event_source_actor_chk.value: ("operator_grant_event"."source" = 'product' and "operator_grant_event"."actor_user_id" is not null) or ("operator_grant_event"."source" <> 'product' and "operator_grant_event"."actor_user_id" is null and "operator_grant_event"."approval_request_id" is null)

media_dims_chk.name: media_dims_chk
media_dims_chk.value: "media"."width" between 1 and 10000 and "media"."height" between 1 and 10000 and "media"."bytes" between 1 and 5242880

job_lock_chk.name: job_lock_chk
job_lock_chk.value: ("job"."status" = 'running') = ("job"."locked_by" is not null and "job"."locked_until" is not null)

payment_attempt_amount_chk.name: payment_attempt_amount_chk
payment_attempt_amount_chk.value: "payment_attempt"."amount_idr" >= 0 and "payment_attempt"."admin_fee_idr" >= 0 and "payment_attempt"."total_idr" = "payment_attempt"."amount_idr" + "payment_attempt"."admin_fee_idr" and "payment_attempt"."total_idr" <= 9007199254740991 and ("payment_attempt"."provider_fee_idr" is null or "payment_attempt"."provider_fee_idr" >= 0)

payment_attempt_accepted_chk.name: payment_attempt_accepted_chk
payment_attempt_accepted_chk.value: ("payment_attempt"."request_state" <> 'accepted' or ("payment_attempt"."transaction_id" is not null and "payment_attempt"."instruction" is not null)) and ("payment_attempt"."status" <> 'paid' or "payment_attempt"."paid_at" is not null)

access_event_full_chk.name: access_event_full_chk
access_event_full_chk.value: "personal_data_access_event"."access_level" = 'masked' or ("personal_data_access_event"."case_id" is not null and "personal_data_access_event"."expires_at" is not null and "personal_data_access_event"."expires_at" > "personal_data_access_event"."created_at")

tax_computation_kind.name: tax_computation_kind
tax_computation_kind.value: "tax_computation"."source_kind" = 'affiliate_payout' and (("tax_computation"."kind" = 'original' and "tax_computation"."corrects_computation_id" is null and "tax_computation"."correction_key" is null) or ("tax_computation"."kind" = 'correction' and "tax_computation"."corrects_computation_id" is not null and "tax_computation"."correction_key" is not null))

tax_document_subject.name: tax_document_subject
tax_document_subject.value: ("tax_document"."subject_kind" = 'affiliate' and coalesce("tax_document"."affiliate_id" > 0, false) and "tax_document"."store_id" is null) or ("tax_document"."subject_kind" = 'store' and coalesce("tax_document"."store_id" > 0, false) and "tax_document"."affiliate_id" is null)

tax_document_kind.name: tax_document_kind
tax_document_kind.value: "tax_document"."kind" in ('earnings_statement','withholding_slip','vat_invoice','credit_note','annual_tax_statement') and ("tax_document"."kind" = 'earnings_statement' or "tax_document"."tax_computation_id" is not null or "tax_document"."subscription_invoice_id" is not null)

tax_entity_profile_confirmed.name: tax_entity_profile_confirmed
tax_entity_profile_confirmed.value: "tax_entity_profile"."status" <> 'confirmed' or ("tax_entity_profile"."legal_name" is not null and "tax_entity_profile"."entity_kind_label" is not null and "tax_entity_profile"."npwp_sealed" is not null and "tax_entity_profile"."npwp_key_version" is not null and "tax_entity_profile"."pkp_status" <> 'unknown' and "tax_entity_profile"."confirmed_by" is not null)

tax_identity_subject.name: tax_identity_subject
tax_identity_subject.value: ("tax_identity"."subject_kind" = 'affiliate' and coalesce("tax_identity"."affiliate_id" > 0, false) and "tax_identity"."store_id" is null) or ("tax_identity"."subject_kind" = 'store' and coalesce("tax_identity"."store_id" > 0, false) and "tax_identity"."affiliate_id" is null)

tax_identity_sealed.name: tax_identity_sealed
tax_identity_sealed.value: ("tax_identity"."id_sealed" is not null and "tax_identity"."id_key_version" is not null and "tax_identity"."registered_name_sealed" is not null and "tax_identity"."id_fingerprint" is not null and "tax_identity"."fingerprint_key_id" is not null) or ("tax_identity"."status" = 'withdrawn' and "tax_identity"."id_sealed" is null and "tax_identity"."id_key_version" is null and "tax_identity"."registered_name_sealed" is null and "tax_identity"."id_fingerprint" is null and "tax_identity"."fingerprint_key_id" is null)

tax_policy_type.name: tax_policy_type
tax_policy_type.value: ("tax_policy_version"."tax_type_code" = 'commission_withholding' and "tax_policy_version"."category_code" in ('individual','entity') and "tax_policy_version"."recognition_event" = 'payout_paid') or ("tax_policy_version"."tax_type_code" = 'vat_output' and "tax_policy_version"."category_code" in ('subscription','cod_fee') and "tax_policy_version"."recognition_event" in ('invoice_created','payment_confirmed'))

tax_policy_parameters.name: tax_policy_parameters
tax_policy_parameters.value: "tax_policy_version"."base_fraction_bps" between 0 and 10000 and "tax_policy_version"."rate_method" in ('per_payment','cumulative_true_up') and "tax_policy_version"."rounding" in ('floor','half_up','ceil') and jsonb_typeof("tax_policy_version"."brackets") = 'array' and jsonb_array_length("tax_policy_version"."brackets") > 0 and ("tax_policy_version"."deposit_due_day" is null or "tax_policy_version"."deposit_due_day" between 1 and 31) and ("tax_policy_version"."report_due_day" is null or "tax_policy_version"."report_due_day" between 1 and 31)

tax_policy_state.name: tax_policy_state
tax_policy_state.value: "tax_policy_version"."status" in ('draft','submitted','confirmed','rejected','retired') and "tax_policy_version"."version" > 0 and ("tax_policy_version"."effective_to" is null or "tax_policy_version"."effective_to" > "tax_policy_version"."effective_from")

tax_policy_confirmation.name: tax_policy_confirmation
tax_policy_confirmation.value: "tax_policy_version"."status" not in ('confirmed','retired') or ("tax_policy_version"."confirmed_by" is not null and "tax_policy_version"."confirmed_at" is not null and coalesce("tax_policy_version"."confirmation_basis" in ('advisor','owner_decision'), false) and ("tax_policy_version"."confirmation_basis" is distinct from 'advisor' or nullif(btrim("tax_policy_version"."advisor_confirmation_ref"), '') is not null) and ("tax_policy_version"."tax_type_code" <> 'commission_withholding' or ("tax_policy_version"."confirmation_basis" is not distinct from 'advisor' and "tax_policy_version"."authored_by" <> "tax_policy_version"."confirmed_by" and "tax_policy_version"."deposit_due_day" is not null and "tax_policy_version"."report_due_day" is not null)))

tax_setting_withholding.name: tax_setting_withholding
tax_setting_withholding.value: not "tax_setting"."withholding_enabled" or ("tax_setting"."tax_identity_required_for_payout" and nullif(btrim("tax_setting"."activation_ref"), '') is not null and "tax_setting"."entity_profile_id" is not null)
